repository.name: jobFynder-BE-nestJS
repository.description: This is for BE rewamp to nestJS from nodeJS

commits.message:
Merge origin/main into features (mechanical sync)

Brings `features` up to date with `main` (65 commits, incl. merged PRs #3-#8
and #16) so work that depends on main's tables can be reviewed against
`features`. No behaviour is added here; the only edits beyond the merge are
the fixes below that the combination itself required.

Conflicts resolved (all additive, both sides kept):
- prisma/schema.prisma: Task.isEvolving (features) + Integration Studio
  models (features) + Companies directory, billing, credits, resume
  collaboration, tracked requirements, extension captures (main).
- src/config/configuration.ts, env.validation.ts: dittofeed (features) +
  stripe/razorpay/profileCompleteness (main).
- src/health/health.controller.ts: DittofeedDispatchService and HermesClient
  both injected.
- src/bench/submission.service.ts: getEventsForActivityEmbed (features) kept
  alongside main's reformatted updateSubmissionStatus.
- src/bench/bench.module.ts: main's exports.

Fixes required by the merge:
- Dittofeed webhook controller no longer imports @CsrfExempt: main removed
  the CSRF layer (e74b2db, bearer-token auth), so the decorator file no
  longer exists.
- health.controller.spec passes the new HermesClient argument.
- Two auth specs pass the seventh AuthService argument (identical to the
  fix in PR #17/#18; main's CI is red without it).

Verification: prisma validate + generate clean, tsc --noEmit clean,
nest build clean, jest 79 suites / 488 tests pass.
Not run: migrations against a database. features' pre-Sep-19 migrations sort
before main's later ones; apply with `prisma migrate deploy` on a scratch DB
before promoting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
